description: List Codemate's client case studies (called references on the site), with the client name, industries, services, a summary and the URL. Filter by industry, service or client. Use this when asked what Codemate has delivered, for whom, or for proof of experience in a sector — search_site only returns the closest few matches and mixes in articles.

industry.description: Industry filter, e.g. "Finance and insurance" or just "finance".

lang.description: Which language edition of the site to answer from. Defaults to English.

service.description: Service filter, e.g. "AI and data", "Software development", "Testing".

name: list_references
